context: A mom and son chat at home
purpose: Teach: 早口/あだ名/ニュータウン/ドレッシング/餡/整頓/ポップアップ/シルエット

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、早口、絶対、で、絶対、お話するわよね
lines.en: Sho, your dad really does talk a mile a minute, doesn't he?
lines.style: Warm, affectionate observation. Gentle rhythm, like she's teasing someone she loves. A soft chuckle underneath. Not quite to him, almost to herself.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、あだ名、絶対、ぱっくん、絶対、なんだよ
lines.en: Mom, my nickname really is Pakkun, you know.
lines.style: Quiet insistence. Not argumentative — just matter-of-fact correction from a small person who knows his own truth. Patient, like he's said this before.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今度、本気で、絶対、ニュータウン、絶対、引っ越したい、絶対、なって、ママ、絶対、思ってるの、翔くん
lines.en: You know, I've been thinking we might actually move to the new development nearby.
lines.style: Musing aloud, half-formed thought becoming speech. Gentle, exploratory tone. She's testing the idea out loud, not decided yet. Warm address to Sho like she's including him in her thinking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、サラダの、絶対、ドレッシング、絶対、ぼく、絶対、自分で、絶対、かけたいよ
lines.en: Mom, I really want to put the dressing on my own salad today.
lines.style: Bright, earnest request from a child who's thought about this. Eager without being demanding. The pride of wanting to do something himself underneath.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃんが、本気で、絶対、餡、絶対、入りのお餅、絶対、送ってくれたわよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your grandmother sent us those mochi with bean paste inside again.
lines.style: Gentle announcement, a little warmth for the kindness. Not quite excited but pleased. She's sharing something small and good with him, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ぼく、本気で、絶対、机の上、絶対、整頓、絶対、したよ、ママ
lines.en: I tidied up my desk today, Mom.
lines.style: Small pride in his voice. Not boasting — just genuinely pleased with himself. The kind of thing a child mentions because he wants you to know he tried.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: アプリの、本気で、絶対、ポップアップ、絶対、お知らせ、絶対、たくさん、絶対、来るわよね、翔くん
lines.en: Your phone keeps getting all those app notifications, doesn't it?
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly weary but not irritated. The tone of a mother noticing small modern-life annoyances. A little wry. Addressed softly to Sho like she's sharing something true.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夕日に、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、シルエット、絶対、綺麗だったよ、ママ
lines.en: Your dad's silhouette looked really beautiful at sunset today.
lines.style: Soft, tender recollection. Voice almost hushed. Not quite nostalgic but gentle-knowing. The simplicity of having noticed something lovely and wanting to share it. Trailing off slightly at the end.
